verdict.rationale: CrewAI is primarily a Python framework driven by code/YAML plus a CLI (crewai create/run/test), not a documented public REST/HTTP API for third-party programmatic control; enterprise deployments do expose a REST API for deployed crews, but no OpenAPI/swagger spec is discoverable (probe returned 404s on all candidate paths). This gives AI-native users a path to drive CrewAI programmatically but mostly through Python objects/CLI rather than a formal public API contract. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent confirmation of the enterprise REST API's completeness, and evidence of API stability/versioning for non-enterprise self-hosted use.
